description: KNaThF₆ crystallizes in the trigonal P̅3 space group. K is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of K-F bond distances ranging from 2.66-2.85 Å. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are three shorter (2.25 Å) and three longer (2.46 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Th is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are three shorter (2.28 Å) and six longer (2.43 Å) Th-F bond lengths. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to two equivalent K, one Na, and one Th atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FK₂NaTh tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded to one K, one Na, and two equivalent Th atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FKNaTh₂ tetrahedra.
